close_reason: Delivered in PR #249 (audited 2026-09-06: recover_from reply re-arms heartbeat; live proxy test; CI green)
description: Pre-existing, surfaced by the PR #173 cold audit: the recover_from handle_call replies without setting a GenServer timeout, so the empty-transaction heartbeat is unarmed from unlock until the first commit/apply/fetch re-arms the cadence. fetch_routing's cadence-resuming reply mitigates once clients start fetching. Fix shape: reply with timeout empty_transaction_timeout_ms (or route through noreply_resuming_cadence).

comments.text: Draft PR: https://github.com/bedrock-kv/bedrock/pull/249 — recover_from now replies via GenServer.reply + noreply_resuming_cadence, arming the heartbeat at unlock; repro pinned on both the handler return and a live proxy.

title: Proxy recover_from reply leaves the empty-transaction heartbeat unarmed until first activity
